# SNB&CHF Central Bank Watch

> A leading Swiss macroeconomic analysis platform focused on Swiss National Bank monetary policy, Swiss Franc currency dynamics, and critical perspectives on global financial cycles.

SNB&CHF provides in-depth analysis of Swiss finance, EUR/CHF exchange rates, and Austrian economics perspectives on monetary policy. The site combines original research, curated content, and expert commentary on central banking and financial markets.

## Key Topics

- Swiss Franc (CHF)
- EUR/CHF peg
- Swiss National Bank (SNB)
- Austrian Economics
- Monetary Policy
- Currency Analysis
- Financial Cycles
- Forex Prediction
- Fiscal Policy
- Private Credit Markets
- Federal Reserve
- Bretton Woods
- Exchange Rate Dynamics
- George Dorgan
- CFA Society

## Core Thesis & Philosophy

- [SNB&CHF Central Bank Watch](https://snbchf.com): Leading Swiss macro-economic site focused on SNB and Swiss Franc analysis.
- [About SNB&CHF](https://snbchf.com/about): About page describing snbchf.com as Swiss financial advisory association.
- [Our Core Thesis](https://snbchf.com/about/core-thesis): Core thesis on SNB monetary policy options and EUR/CHF exchange rate dynamics.
- [15 Years of Bubbles, Busts and Failed Monetary Policy](https://snbchf.com/about/manifesto): Manifesto critiquing 15 years of monetary policy and economic inequality.

## Economic Theory & History

- [Economic Theories Overview](https://snbchf.com/economic-theory/economic-overview): Overview of economic theories covering mainstream, heterodox, and Austrian schools.
- [The History of Financial Cycles](https://snbchf.com/history-2/financial-cycles): Historical analysis of financial cycles, Austrian economics, and business cycles.
- [Euro Crisis: A Summary of Relevant Posts](https://snbchf.com/eurocrisis): Curated summary of Euro Crisis posts covering eurozone economics and fiscal policy.

## Research & Analysis

- [Sept 2014, George Dorgan at the CFA Society: Predicted End of EUR/CHF Peg](https://snbchf.com/chf/george-dorgan-cfa-society-slides): George Dorgan's CFA Society presentation on EUR/CHF peg prediction and deflation analysis.
- [Will The Fed Backstop Exuberance Again?](https://snbchf.com/video/roberts-3-19-26-the-fed-backstop-exuberance-again): Lance Roberts and Michael Lebowitz video on Federal Reserve policy and credit markets.
- [Das Fazit nach 20 Jahren Piotroski-Backtest?](https://snbchf.com/video/vittner-das-fazit-nach-20-jahren-piotroski-backtest): Thomas Vittner's 20-year Piotroski F-Score backtesting analysis and results.

## Current Market Commentary

- [Bitcoin kommt von Zwischenhoch zurück. 70'000-Dollar-marke kommt wieder näher](https://snbchf.com/2026/03/ticker-www-finanzen-ch-bitcoin-kommt-zwischenhoch-zuruck-70000-dollar-marke-kommt-wieder-naher): Bitcoin price movement analysis and cryptocurrency market ticker.
- [No, We Cannot "Afford" This War with Iran Either](https://snbchf.com/2026/03/okeeffe-we-cannot-afford-war-iran): Connor O'Keeffe's analysis of war spending and Austrian economics perspective.
- [Why are Pakistan and Afghanistan at War?](https://snbchf.com/video/economist-why-pakistan-afghanistan-war): The Economist video on Pakistan-Afghanistan geopolitical conflict.
